question: Which deities are to be placed and worshipped on the right and left of the door?
premises: Mahālakṣmī is associated with the right side.
Sarasvatī is associated with the left side.
Both placements are part of the door worship context.
inference: Mahālakṣmī should be worshipped on the right and Sarasvatī on the left.
plain_english: On its right side worship Mahālakṣmī, and on the left side Sarasvatī.
